title: Measurement Worksheets: Estimating and Measuring a Book
intro: Use estimation to give a measurement context before reaching for a ruler.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Ask the student to estimate the length of a particular book edge. Measure that same edge from zero and compare the results.

Ask your student

Was the estimate close, and what helped you choose it?

If your student needs help

If the student starts at the ruler's edge rather than zero, show the gap and measure again.

Choosing and using the worksheet

This sheet reuses one fixed original book-measurement task with spaces for estimate, measurement, and difference. It does not supply a book, ruler, or printable ruler. New numbers does not change the task. A different book can be used on another printed copy.
